capabilities.description: Serves a Jellyfin-shaped read-only API that Tracearr can monitor.

global_config_schema.title: Connection
global_config_schema.description: The plugin's Silo admin API key and addresses. The access secret and the Tracearr URL are managed on the Tracearr setup page.

fields.label: Silo admin API key
fields.description: An unscoped API key (starts with sa_) owned by an administrator. The plugin uses it to read sessions and users, and to save the access secret.

fields.label: Access secret
fields.description: Optional here. Leave blank and use the Tracearr setup page (Admin > Plugins > Tracearr Connector) to generate one and get the full URL for Tracearr.

fields.label: Silo API address
fields.description: Where the plugin reaches Silo's main API from inside the Silo container. The default works for the standard Docker setup.

fields.label: Jellyfin-compatible API address
fields.description: Where the plugin reaches Silo's Jellyfin-compatible listener. Used for server info and library data. Allow Jellyfin apps to connect must be on in Silo.

presentation.summary: Lets Tracearr monitor streams, users and sharing on this Silo server.
presentation.description_markdown:
Tracearr monitors Plex, Jellyfin and Emby. This plugin presents Silo to Tracearr as a Jellyfin server, so Tracearr can show live streams from every account, with client IP addresses, and run its sharing detection.

It is read-only. It reads Silo's administrator session and user lists with an admin API key and passes other requests to Silo's Jellyfin-compatible listener.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. In Silo, create an unscoped API key for an administrator account and turn on **Allow Jellyfin apps to connect**.
2. Open this plugin's settings and paste the API key.
3. Open **Tracearr setup** from the plugin's menu, click **Generate access secret**, then click the copy button.
4. In Tracearr, add a **Jellyfin** server and paste the URL. The API key field can hold any value.
5. Keep the URL private: anyone who has it can read your stream list. Don't expose `/api/v1/plugins/` on a public proxy.
